values: Haqdarshak: Digitising Program Management for Scale, Accuracy & Accountability
summary: Haqdarshak Keywords: Operational Excellence, Workflow Digitisation, Financial Management, Beneficiary Data, MIS Accuracy, NGO, India. Organization: Haqdarshak Mission: To enable access to government and financial welfare schemes for underserved citizens through a combination of technology, trained field agents, and institutional partnerships. Scale: Supported 7 million+ beneficiaries across India. Challenge: Rapid scale exposed operational bottlenecks—fragmented order-to-invoice processes created delivery delays and revenue leakage, while inconsistent beneficiary data reduced MIS accuracy and weakened client trust. Solution: Haqdarshak digitised the entire order-to-invoice workflow using Zoho modules and custom integrations, enabling milestone-to-invoice tracking, automated visibility, and predictable cash flows. Beneficiary onboarding on the Agent App was redesigned with structured journeys, validations, and eligibility-engine integration, ensuring accurate, deduplicated data for reporting. Key Technologies: Zoho Suite, Custom Integrations, Agent App, MIS Dashboards, Eligibility Engine. Impact: Achieved 100% digitisation of order-to-invoice workflows, improved cash flow cycles, strengthened data credibility, and enhanced operational coordination across program, finance, CAM, and field teams. The transformation increased accountability, enabled cleaner reporting, and positioned Haqdarshak as a more predictable, scalable, data-driven organisation. Learnings: Co-create with users to drive adoption; tailor levers for fence-sitters vs. early adopters; keep workflows simple, time-bound, and tightly aligned with real operational needs.
short_description: Streamlining the order-to-invoice process and beneficiary onboarding to strengthen financial management, data credibility, and operational efficiency.

values: SEWA Bharat - Digitising a Grassroots Women’s Movement
summary: SEWA Bharat Keywords: Operational Excellence, Digital Transformation, Capacity Building, Outreach, Fundraising, Grassroots Women’s Empowerment, India. Organization: SEWA Bharat Mission: To support women workers in India's informal economy through financial inclusion, training, enterprise support, and community leadership. Scale: Active across India with millions of women benefiting through SEWA Shakti Kendras. Challenge: SEWA Bharat faced fragmented digital systems, low online visibility, no integrated fundraising infrastructure, limited analytics, and low digital readiness among field teams—restricting outreach, donor engagement, and scalability. Solution: SEWA Bharat partnered with Digital For Nonprofits (D4NP) to implement a phased digital transformation. This included grant activation (Google Workspace, Ad Grants, Microsoft), website and SEO upgrades, donation gateway integration, analytics instrumentation, Google Ads campaigns, and extensive capacity building—training 500+ staff and grassroots leaders to adopt AI and digital tools. Key Technologies: Google Workspace, Google Ad Grants, Google My Business, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, Razorpay, Mailchimp, Tidio Chatbot, ChatGPT Assistant, Canva, Adobe, Microsoft tools. Impact: SEWA Bharat achieved rapid digital growth: 50+ SSKs listed on Google My Business, 12M+ impressions via Google Ads, doubled engagement across nine channels, tripled website traffic, seamless digital donations via Razorpay, and widespread AI adoption for content creation and community communication. Learnings: Digital adoption succeeds when paired with capacity building; hyperlocal discoverability drives grassroots engagement; and phased transformation ensures cultural alignment and sustainable long-term ownership.
short_description: SEWA Bharat is a national federation supporting women workers in India’s informal economy.

values: Saajha: Scaling Parental Engagement Through Digital Enablement
summary: Saajha Keywords: Digital Transformation, Parental Engagement, WhatsApp Delivery, FLN Learning, Program Scale, Data-Driven Monitoring, NGO, India. Organization: Saajha Mission: To strengthen parental engagement so children receive the academic and emotional support needed to thrive. Scale: Supports 2,40,000+ parents across Delhi and NOIDA. Learnings: Technology succeeds when users are prepared; simple tools outperform complex ones; standardisation enables scalable and equitable reach.
